prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Leaf cat mascot illustration. REMOVE ALL EYEGLASSES COMPLETELY. Remove both green circular spectacle rims, bridge, temples and any glasses on the forehead. Fill those removed parts naturally with the same solid charcoal cat fur. Keep the ivory oval eyes and pupils in their current positions, or keep the closed sleeping eyes for the sleeping pose. No eye outlines, no green rings, no eyewear of any kind anywhere in the image. Keep the cat recognizable and cute. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE: same head/ear/body proportions, pose, expression, paws, whiskers, tail, book or other props, sage-green and ivory palette, hand-drawn matte style, composition and generous margins. For the searching cat only, the raised paw can rest against its temple naturally instead of holding glasses. True TRANSPARENT alpha background; clean crisp cutout, no glow, no shadows, no added background, no text, no logo. One image, one cat. This request specifically overrides the reference's glasses: final character must be WITHOUT GLASSES.

assets.prompt: Create the missing-page (404) scene for the Leaf app using this exact cute black cat character as reference.
